notes: PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 is the phase authorised to widen safe_minimal, so it had to move a whole-file pin two earlier phases took. This fixture makes the move checkable rather than asserted: applying every `post` -> `pre` replacement below to the shipped patching/patch_gates.py reproduces the pre-LIVE.2 file byte for byte, and that file hashes to pre_sha256 - the exact digest tests/fixtures/defect_probe_live4_frozen_boundaries.json and tests/fixtures/candidate_verify_live1_frozen_boundaries.json used to carry.
Every hunk is stored with three lines of context and is asserted unique in the shipped file, so the reconstruction is deterministic and cannot silently match the wrong region.
changed_top_level_definitions records what actually moved: of the file's 35 top-level definitions, only _enforce_safe_minimal has a different AST. Nothing else in the patch-gate surface changed.
